review.item_premise: Credential owns only two protected Home handles with fixed Debug; CredentialError contains only public failure classes and has constant Display and no source. The instrumented construction and completion return only this protected owner or a content-free outcome. Owning-module diagnostics exercise a real wrong-pairing refusal. This confirmation covers the recorded surface only; it does not admit primitive stack residue or enable an executable consumer. The separate consumer inventory remains held under ROOT::amend:crypto:protected-verifier-residue.
